language.name: English
app.name: Wizard101 Chat Translator
notice.game_missing: ⚠  Game not ready or disconnected — waiting…
notice.access_denied: ⚠  Access denied: the game runs elevated — restart this program as administrator
notice.hotkeys_unavailable: ⚠  Hotkeys unavailable: the keyboard hook could not be installed — restart this program
notice.config_unsaved: ⚠  Settings could not be saved and will be lost when you exit — check that the program folder is writable
notice.version_mismatch: ⚠  Game version not supported: update both the game and this app to the latest version; if both are current, this app does not support this game build yet — please wait for an update
notice.config_error: ⚠  API settings are invalid — open settings (⚙) to check
notice.config_error_detail: ⚠  API responded with HTTP {status}: {message} — open settings (⚙) to check
notice.config_error_http: ⚠  API responded with HTTP {status} — open settings (⚙) to check
notice.offline_http: ⚠  Translation server responded with HTTP {status}: {message} — retrying…
notice.offline_status: ⚠  Translation server responded with HTTP {status} — retrying…
notice.offline_detail: ⚠  Cannot reach the translation server: {message} — retrying…
update.available: ⬆  Version {version} is available — click to download
error.bad_key: The API key is invalid or expired. Check your API key.
error.model_not_found: Model not found. Check the model name.
error.api_http: API settings are invalid (HTTP {status}). Check each field.
error.offline: Cannot reach the server. Check the URL and your network.
provider.openai_desc: OpenAI's official API. Just paste your API key.
provider.claude_desc: Anthropic's official API. Just paste your API key.
provider.gemini_desc: Google's official API. Just paste your API key.
provider.custom_desc: Any OpenAI-compatible service, self-hosted or third-party. You provide the server URL.
service.slots_title: Use a different service per feature (advanced)
service.slots_hint: Anything left unset uses the default service.
service.confirm_delete_in_use: Delete “{name}”? Anything set to use it will go back to the default service.
service.keep_one: Keep at least one service — the last one cannot be deleted.
field.auto_input: Open and close the translation input with the game chat box
field.paste_hotkey: Type the clipboard into the game when Ctrl+V is pressed in it (the game cannot paste)
field.translate_system: Translate game system messages (drops, XP, level-up broadcasts)
hint.model_idle: Click Refresh list to fetch the model list from the server, or type a model name yourself.
hint.model_no_list: This endpoint does not provide a model list. Enter the model name yourself.
hint.model_empty: The server reported 0 available models. Enter the model name yourself.
hint.model_found: Found {count} models. Type to filter, or enter a name that is not listed.
hint.language: The list is just common choices — you can type any language name, for example Italiano or ภาษาไทย.
hint.thinking: Turn thinking on with a low depth, or turn it off. Which is faster depends on the model; press "Test connection" a few times for each to compare the times. Some models can't turn thinking off; the test will show an error.
hint.thinking_always: This model always thinks; thinking can't be turned off.
hint.effort: Models support different thinking depths. If you pick one the model doesn't support, the test shows an error; if you're not sure, choose "Auto". Higher depths make translations slower and use more tokens.
hint.effort_known: Higher depths make translations slower and use more tokens; if you're not sure, choose "Auto".
hint.custom_endpoint: Enter the URL of any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as LM Studio, Ollama, or vLLM. Give the host and port only (for example http://127.0.0.1:8000) — do not add /v1 or any other path.
settings.title: {app} — Settings
settings.hotkey: Hotkey to open the translation input
settings.fade_hint: 0 = never fade; scroll back through history
settings.max_messages_hint: Oldest messages are removed beyond this
settings.parallel_hint: 1 = one at a time; higher values translate several at once and keep up better in busy chat
settings.type_delay_hint: Increase this if the game drops characters
settings.alpha_hint: Live preview; lower is more transparent (default {default})
about.author: Developer
about.logs_hint: When reporting an issue, attach app.log and messages.log from this folder
about.cache_hint: Cached translations of system messages; clearing them makes the next one translate again
about.cache_clear_failed: Could not delete the cache file. Try again later.
error.need_target_language: Select or enter a target language.
wizard.title: {app} — Setup
wizard.language_hint: Choose the language this app uses.
wizard.intro: This tool translates Wizard101 chat in real time, and lets you type in your own language and send it to the game in English.
wizard.pick_provider: Choose the translation provider you want to use.
wizard.intro_form: Fill in the settings, then use Test connection to confirm it works (it really does translate a sample line).
wizard.target_language: Target language (what incoming messages are translated into)
input.hint: Type a message and press Enter to translate it and type it into the game's input box (it is not sent automatically). Press Esc, or Enter on an empty box, to close this window.
input.too_long: The translation is {count} characters, over the game limit of {limit} — trim it or split it up.
region.hint: Drag to select the area to translate, Esc to cancel
region.outside_game: Select an area inside the game window
region.game_minimized: Restore the game window first — it is minimized
region.ocr_unavailable: Local text recognition failed to start
region.no_game: Game window not found; start the game and log in first
settings.region_hotkey: Hotkey to translate a selected screen area
error.hotkeys_same: The two hotkeys must be different.
error.hotkey_is_paste: Ctrl+V cannot be a hotkey while in-game paste is on.
error.base_url_scheme: The server URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.base_url_v1: Leave /v1 off the end of the server URL; give only the host and port (for example http://127.0.0.1:8000).
glossary.confirm_delete_active: Delete “{name}”? It is in use, so no glossary will be used afterwards.
error.glossary_duplicate_source: “{name}” has entries with the same source.
glossary.name: Name
glossary.builtin_missing: The included built-in glossary no longer exists.
glossary.same_as_builtin: Same as the built-in glossary; it will be removed when saved.
glossary.row_duplicate_source: Same source as an earlier entry.
glossary.row_incomplete: Fill in both the source and the target.
glossary.merge_conflicts: {n} with the same source but a different target
glossary.merge_hint: Checked rows take the file's target; unchecked rows keep the current one.
